title: A monogenic extension of a Nagata domain is Japanese
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be integral domains with an injective algebra map $A\to B$. Assume $A$ is Nagata [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring] and $B=A[x]$ for some $x\in B$. Then $B$ is N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain] with respect to its fraction field.

proof.text: If x is algebraic over A, apply the algebraic monogenic theorem.

Otherwise evaluation A[X] -> B is injective by transcendence and surjective because x generates B. A is Noetherian and N-2 by the Nagata-domain lemma, hence A[X] is N-2 by polynomial ascent. Regard the evaluation isomorphism as an injective finite domain extension and apply ascent of N-2 to obtain N-2 for B.
